approved.en: US envoy Steve Witkoff met President Putin in Russia after a positive meeting with President Zelenskyy, and during the talks Russia freed American Stephen Hubbard, who had been jailed for fighting for Ukraine. Ukraine conducted its first drone airlift of a wounded soldier from the front line, demonstrating a new evacuation capability. Russian forces continued strikes in Kyiv, killing four people, injuring two, and a separate drone attack wounded five people at a hospital. NATO increased patrol plane deployments in the Black Sea in response to the heightened Russian attacks. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: US-ambassadør Steve Witkoff møtte president Putin i Russland etter et positivt møte med president Zelenskyj, og under samtalene frigjorde Russland amerikaneren Stephen Hubbard, som hadde blitt fengslet for å kjempe for Ukraina. Ukraina gjennomførte sin første dronelufttransport av en såret soldat fra frontlinjen, og demonstrerte en ny evakueringskapasitet. Russiske styrker fortsatte angrep i Kyiv, hvor fire personer ble drept og to såret, og et separat droneangrep såret fem personer på et sykehus. NATO økte antallet patruljefly i Svartehavet som svar på de økte russiske angrepene. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli police detained ten settlers who attacked a photographer, a French mayor and other civilians, torched cars and olive trees, and wounded farmers in the West Bank. US politician Brad Lander and rabbis were briefly detained by Israeli forces during an olive harvest in the West Bank. UNICEF reports that 340 children have been killed in Gaza despite a ceasefire, while Gaza children face worsening food shortages as prices rise and aid is cut. A moderate settler group expressed support for what they described as "polite" ethnic cleansing. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

US-politiker Brad Lander og rabbiner ble kortvarig holdt i varetekt av israelske styrker under en oliveninnhøsting på Vestbredden. UNICEF rapporterer at 340 barn er drept i Gaza til tross for våpenhvile, mens barna i Gaza opplever stadig verre matmangel etter hvert som prisene stiger og hjelpen kuttes. En moderat bosettergruppe uttrykte støtte til det de beskrev som en «høflig» etnisk rensing. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. Houthi forces have continued striking Yemeni army and government training camps, killing dozens of recruits in Shabwa and other locations. There were 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Turkish forces remain deployed in Syria and Iraq until border security is assured, and Iraqi troops have been redeployed between Kirkuk and Baghdad amid IS plans to increase attacks in fragile regions. An IRGC officer was killed in the Iran-Iraq border mountains during clashes with Kurdish opposition, and Iraq has threatened a crackdown on opponents of its weapons-control and disarmament plan. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Tyrkiske styrker er fortsatt utplassert i Syria og Irak inntil grensesikkerheten er sikret, og irakiske soldater er omplassert mellom Kirkuk og Bagdad etter at IS planlegger å øke angrep i skjøre regioner. En IRGC-offiser ble drept i fjellene på Iran-Irak-grensen under sammenstøt med kurdisk opposisjon, og Irak har truet med en nedslag på motstandere av sin våpenkontroll‑ og avrustningsplan. UN-mediated peace efforts have resumed, aiming to end the drone war that is fueling the humanitarian crisis. The UN Security Council is holding a live session on the conflict’s spread, drones and the deadly impact of hunger. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Sudanese armed forces carried out a drone strike on Abyei’s Amiet market, killing dozens and injuring many, and a separate drone strike hit a market in the disputed Abyei border region, also causing high casualties. In Ruweng fresh attacks left nine dead and six wounded, while bodies arrived from the Khor Kaltan killings in Northern Bahr el Ghazal. Communal clashes continued, including 14 deaths between Warrap and Lakes communities and the arrest of a traditional chief over a Juba youth killing. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Ruweng førte friske angrep til ni døde og seks sårede, mens lik ankom fra drapene i Khor Kaltan i Nord-Bahr el Ghazal. Kommunale sammenstøt fortsatte, inkludert 14 dødsfall mellom Warrap‑ og Lakes-samfunnene og arrestasjonen av en tradisjonell høvding over et drap på en ungdom i Juba. UCDP registrerte to kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have installed a caretaker administration in Tigray and are moving toward the Eritrean border, while a pro-government militia says it seized the regional airport and reports Eritrean forces suffered losses there. The United States, through Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate, and Mekelle mayor Shishay Amare announced elections within six months to settle Western Tigray through constitutional processes. A drone strike in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73 people, and the TPLF claims to have killed 1,511 Ethiopian soldiers in recent fighting. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA, gjennom utenriksminister Marco Rubio, oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å de-eskalere, og Mekelle borgermester Shishay Amare kunngjorde valg innen seks måneder for å løse Vest-Tigray gjennom konstitusjonelle prosesser. Et droneangrep i det omstridte Abyei-området drepte minst 73 personer, og TPLF hevder å ha drept 1 511 etiopiske soldater i nylige kamper. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia announced the withdrawal of more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as its own civil war intensifies and has refused to intervene in the South West State conflict. UCDP recorded 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Al Shabaab detonerte en IED i Mandera, og seks sivile ble skadet, og Røde Kors behandlede 148 sårede etter tung kamp i Baidoa. Etiopia kunngjorde at mer enn 3 000 soldater trekkes tilbake fra Somalia ettersom egen borgerkrig intensiveres, og har nektet å intervenere i konflikten i South West State. approved.en: Ebola has expanded to an eighth province in the DRC, prompting heightened alerts in Lubumbashi and calls for border closures. Kenyan and other long-distance truck drivers suspended DRC-bound cargo after 12 drivers were killed, leading Kenya to halt operations and Uganda to close its border over Ebola fears. Rebel groups including the FRN near Lubumbashi and the ADF in Ituri continued attacks that killed civilians and threatened regional security. The African Union is urging cease-fire compliance and inclusive dialogue. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Opprørsgrupper inkludert FRN nær Lubumbashi og ADF i Ituri fortsatte angrep som drepte sivile og truet regional sikkerhet. Den afrikanske unionen oppfordrer til overholdelse av våpenhvile og inkluderende dialog. Konflikten forårsaket 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
